characters.rig: same skeleton with independent timing and pose offsets

shots.name: Hook
shots.action: The mirror is already occupied; a direct warning opens the story

shots.name: First impossible motion
shots.action: At 02:13 the reflection blinks and raises its arm before Adam

shots.name: The warning
shots.action: Adam freezes; the reflection writes the word اهرب on the glass
shots.retention: A concrete instruction creates a new question

shots.name: The voice behind him
shots.action: Adam hears his own voice behind him but refuses to turn

shots.name: Broken reflection
shots.action: The mirror stops reflecting Adam; the room blacks out and Adam disappears

shots.name: Viewer-directed twist
shots.action: The reflection smiles at the lens; the final caption reveals it was looking at the viewer

psychology_notes: Open with a clear threat before explaining context.
Introduce the anomaly early, then delay the full explanation.
Use a repeated visual rule (reflection copies Adam) so breaking it is immediately legible.
Turn the mirror word into a specific question: what is Adam meant to run from?
Escalate from visual anomaly to sound cue to disappearance.
Resolve the mystery by changing the target from Adam to the viewer.
safety_and_rights: Original fictional story; no real-person allegation, franchise character, or third-party footage is used.
